title: Proverbs & Meanings
sub: Read the proverb, then recall its meaning.

cards.q: A stitch in time saves nine.
cards.a: Fix a small problem early to avoid a bigger one later.

cards.q: Actions speak louder than words.
cards.a: What you do matters more than what you say.

cards.q: All that glitters is not gold.
cards.a: Appearances can be deceiving.
cards.note: Shakespeare used a version in The Merchant of Venice.

cards.q: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
cards.a: A sure thing is better than a risky possibility.
cards.note: Advice to value what you have.

cards.q: Better late than never.
cards.a: It is better to do something late than not at all.

cards.q: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
cards.a: Don't rely on a result that hasn't happened yet.

cards.q: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
cards.a: Don't risk everything on one thing.

cards.q: Every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.a: Even bad situations have some good in them.

cards.q: Fortune favors the bold.
cards.a: Those who take risks are more likely to succeed.

cards.q: Honesty is the best policy.
cards.a: Telling the truth is the wisest course.

cards.q: If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
cards.a: Leave working things alone.

cards.q: It takes two to tango.
cards.a: Both parties share responsibility.

cards.q: Look before you leap.
cards.a: Think carefully before acting.

cards.q: Many hands make light work.
cards.a: Tasks go faster when people share them.

cards.q: No pain, no gain.
cards.a: Progress requires effort and discomfort.

cards.q: Out of sight, out of mind.
cards.a: We forget what we don't see.

cards.q: Practice makes perfect.
cards.a: Repetition builds skill.

cards.q: Rome wasn't built in a day.
cards.a: Great things take time.

cards.q: The early bird catches the worm.
cards.a: Those who act early gain the advantage.

cards.q: The pen is mightier than the sword.
cards.a: Words and ideas have more power than force.

cards.q: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
cards.a: Too many people on a task ruin it.

cards.q: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
cards.a: Follow the customs of where you are.

cards.q: You can't judge a book by its cover.
cards.a: Don't judge by appearances alone.

cards.q: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
cards.a: A true friend helps in hard times.

cards.q: Barking dogs seldom bite.
cards.a: Those who threaten loudly rarely act.

cards.q: Beggars can't be choosers.
cards.a: When you need help, accept what is offered.

cards.q: Birds of a feather flock together.
cards.a: People with similar traits stay together.

cards.q: Curiosity killed the cat.
cards.a: Being too inquisitive can get you into trouble.
cards.note: Often completed with 'but satisfaction brought it back.'

cards.q: Don't bite the hand that feeds you.
cards.a: Don't harm those who support you.

cards.q: Easy come, easy go.
cards.a: What is gained effortlessly is lost easily.

cards.q: Familiarity breeds contempt.
cards.a: Knowing someone too well can cause disrespect.

cards.q: Great minds think alike.
cards.a: Smart people often reach the same ideas.

cards.q: Haste makes waste.
cards.a: Rushing leads to mistakes.

cards.q: Knowledge is power.
cards.a: Understanding gives you influence.

cards.q: Laughter is the best medicine.
cards.a: Humor helps heal stress and pain.

cards.q: Necessity is the mother of invention.
cards.a: Need drives people to create solutions.

cards.q: The grass is always greener on the other side.
cards.a: Others' situations seem better than your own.

cards.q: There's no smoke without fire.
cards.a: Rumors usually have some truth behind them.

cards.q: Slow and steady wins the race.
cards.a: Consistent effort beats fast, erratic bursts.

cards.q: Two wrongs don't make a right.
cards.a: Revenge doesn't fix a wrong.

cards.q: Where there's a will, there's a way.
cards.a: Determination finds a path.
